mmd_normal.png.description: Synthetic distributions with the same mean and covariance, compared by Frechet distance and MMD (Table 2). Copied byte-for-byte from lectures/supplementary/figs/mmd_normal.png.

vqgan_reconstructions.jpg.description: Esser et al., Taming Transformers, Figure 12, top row. Original JPEG unchanged. The slide viewport shows its first three columns (input, DALL-E discrete VAE f8/8192, VQGAN f8/8192); both f16 columns remain outside the viewport. This is a complete-model comparison, not a loss ablation.

prompt_relation.svg.description: Original explanatory SVG created for Lecture 5 to illustrate the cited paper's motivation about spatial-relation errors. Not copied or traced from the paper. Same red cube and blue sphere with vertical relation reversed. Qualitative schematic only; no measured metric scores.

alice_ai_art_2_evaluation.png.description: Author-selected Alice AI ART 2.0 image-editing evaluation figure from the Yandex article. Original downloaded PNG retained byte-for-byte, including Russian labels. Shows relevance, preservation, and defects with good/bad examples.
